checks.finding: Every REQ-001..REQ-011 pairs to named diagnostics, exit codes, or measurable fixture outcomes (e.g. REQ-006's approver-registry addition names DUPLICATE_APPROVER_REGISTRY_ID and defines minItems:0 + id/name required fields, requirements.md:622-648, 1777-1791; REQ-003's canonicalizer rejection categories each get a named diagnostic, lines 240-283). No in-scope requirement relies on unmeasurable language.

Each REQ-001..REQ-011 goal traces to at least one AC in acceptance-tests.md/requirements.md's Acceptance Criteria section; the round-2 addition (approver-registry schema, REQ-006) traces to AC-044/AC-045/AC-046 (requirements.md:1704-1739; acceptance-tests.md TEST-044..046).

Acceptance criteria specify externally observable fixture outcomes (schema validate/reject, exact diagnostics, byte-for-byte hash equality, exit codes). AC-044 (schema conformance incl. malformed-registry rejection), AC-045 (duplicate-id rejection), AC-046 (zero-identity verdict + structural fail-closed signing) are each stated as concrete, falsifiable fixture behavior (requirements.md:1704-1739).

Non-goals section (requirements.md:1187-1254) explicitly excludes the Reverse Coverage Gate, provider-vocabulary fixing, Capability Registry/Resolver/Facet Manifest work, a live sdd-forge project-context instance, wiring beyond A1-time entry points, Artifact/Promotion Gate work, sdd-delivery/operability plugins, running the review loops themselves, and tasks.md/traceability.md authorship -- each with a stated rationale or forced-handoff gate.

Security/approval boundaries are stated in the Security Boundaries table (B1-B8, requirements.md:2148-2159) and Roles and Permissions (1908-1951); the approver-registry addition states its own constraint explicitly -- uniqueness is a schema-external semantic check with a named diagnostic, run before REQ-006's distinct-identity count (requirements.md:631-648), and the registry's zero-entry state is declared non-error but structurally fail-closed for signing (Edge Cases, 2035-2053).

The Risks section (requirements.md:2210-2282) pairs every Critical/High/Medium/Low risk with a specific REQ/AC mitigation (e.g. Critical forgery risk -> REQ-004/REQ-007/AC-023; High under-classification risk -> AC-016/AC-017). The round-1 approver-registry gap itself now has an explicit validation surface: AC-044/045/046.
